WITH inventory_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.productid,
        p.name,
        pi.locationid,
        pi.quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS rank
    FROM adventureworks.production.productinventory pi
    JOIN adventureworks.production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
    WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4
)
SELECT 
    productid AS "产品ID",
    name AS "名称",
    locationid AS "库位ID",
    quantity AS "数量",
    rank AS "排名"
FROM inventory_data
ORDER BY locationid, quantity DESC
